recentItems.title: How a Chinese factory is helping turn "Made in Senegal" into a reality
recentItems.description: At Twyford Senegal, local workers are rising from new recruits to team leaders and passing their skills on. The Chinese-invested tile factory supports nearly 1,900 long-term jobs, helping Senegal shift from imported tiles to local production.

recentItems.title: Culture Goes Global: How a Chinese county is taking Hanfu and peonies overseas
recentItems.description: What do Hanfu (traditional Chinese attire) and peonies have in common? In Heze City, east China's Shandong Province, they're becoming a new way to take Chinese culture global. From traditional clothing makers to peony-based product companies, local businesses are using culture to open doors to overseas markets.
